lines.rom: sri saniscara devaji sunahu sravana mam tera koti vighnanasaka prabho karo na mam hita bera
sanideva maim sumiraum tohi vidya buddhi jnana do mohi
tumharo nama aneka bakhanaum ksudrabuddhi maim jo kucha janaum
antaka kona raudraya manaum krsna babhru sani sabahim sunaum
pimgala mandasauri sukha data hita anahita saba jaga ke jnata
nita japai jo nama tumhara karahu vyadhi duhkha se nistara
rasi visamavasa asurana suranara pannaga sesa sahita vidyadhara
raja ramka rahahim jo niko pasu paksi vanacara sabahi ko
kanana kila sivira senakara nasa karata saba gramya nagara bhara
dalata vighna sabahi ke sukha mem vyakula hohim pare saba duhkha mem
natha vinaya tumase yaha meri kariye mopara daya ghaneri
mama hita visama rasi mahamvasa kariya na natha yahi mama asa
jo gura urada de bara sanicara tila java loha anna dhana bastara
dana diye se homya sukhari soi sani suna yaha vinaya hamari
natha daya tuma mopara kijai kotika vighna ksanika maham chijai
vamdata natha jugala kara jori sunahu daya kara vinati mori
kabahumka tiratha raja prayaga sarayu tora sahita anuraga
kabahum sarasvati suddha nara maham ya kahum giri khoha kamdara maham
dhyana dharata haim jo jogi jani tahi dhyana maham suksma hohi sani
hai agamya kya karum barai karata pranama carana sira nai
jo videsa se bara sanicara murakara avega nija ghara para
rahaim sukhi sani deva duhai raksa ravi suta rakhaim banai
jo videsa javaim sanivara grha avaim nahim sahai dukhara
samkata deya sanicara tahi jete dukhi hoi mana mahi
soi ravi nandana kara jori vandana karata murha mati thori
brahma jagata banavana hara visnu sabahim nita deta ahara
haim trisuladhari tripurari vibhu deva murati eka vari
ikahoi dharana karata sani nita vamdata soi sani ko damanacita
jo nara patha karai mana cita se so nara chutai vyatha amita se
haum suputra dhana santati barhe kali kala kara jore tharhe
pasu kutumba bamdhana adi se bharo bhavana rahihaim nita sabase
nana bhamti bhoga sukha sara anta samaya tajakara samsara
pavai mukti amara pada bhai jo nita sani sama dhyana lagai
parhai prata jo nama sani dasa rahaim saniscara nita usake basa
pira sani ki kabahum na hoi nita utha dhyana dharai jo koi
jo yaha patha karaim calisa hoya sukha sakhi jagadisa
calisa dina nita parhai sabere pataka nasai sani ghanere
ravi nandana ki asa prabhutai jagata mohatama nasai bhai
yako patha karai jo koi sukha sampati ki kami na hoi
nisidina dhyana dharai manamahim adhivyadhi dhimga avai nahim
patha saniscara deva ko kinhaum vimala taiyara karata patha calisa dina ho bhavasagara para
jo stuti dasaratha ji kiyo sammukha sani nihara sarasa subhasa mem vahi lalita likhem sudhara
